news.h: Breece Hall proclaims himself ready to play
news.d: Report on the imminent return of Jets RB Breece Hall.

news.h: Jets' Breece Hall says he's ready to play, cites threats for social media exit
news.d: Breece Hall proclaimed himself ready to play Sunday after missing five games with a quad injury -- a period in which he received hostile social media messages.

news.h: Jets' Garrett Wilson in concussion protocol, Breece Hall trending toward return
news.d: Jets wide receiver Garrett Wilson is in the concussion protocol, but running back Breece Hall is "trending in the right direction" toward returning.

news.h: Aaron Glenn says Breece Hall is Jets' starter despite Braelon Allen's emergence
news.d: Braelon Allen has rushed for the second-most yards behind Bucky Irving in Breece Hall's five-game absence.
